summary: Iteration 5: end-to-end verification of the new admin flow (single upcoming slot only, A/B/C save, Hold/Release with 60s auto-reveal window, change password). Backend: 11/11 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_admin_upcoming_hold_password.py, covering auth, upcoming payload shape, save persistence + validation, hold->release semantics (including masking on GET /api/board/today when a past-time slot is held within the 60s window and auto-reveal after), change-password happy path + wrong-current + full login cycle with revert. Frontend (Playwright, /admin): login works, admin panel shows exactly one admin-upcoming-card with one admin-upcoming-time (8:30 PM shown), NO table of past slots (0 tables on page); A/B/C edit + Save persists (77/88/99); Hold toggles to Release and Release toggles back; change-password form works end-to-end (changed to NewTemp_1234, logged in successfully, reverted to shivshakti2026 and verified login). Public root '/' still loads NPL1 board. Password reset back to shivshakti2026 at end as required.

minor.issue: No minimum-strength validation beyond length>=6; also does not invalidate other outstanding JWTs (they remain valid for 12h). Consider bumping a per-user password_version claim.
Hold can be applied to any slot on any date (including already-past days) with no time guard; UI only exposes it for the upcoming slot but the endpoint itself has no server-side restriction.

Definition of 'upcoming' is 'first slot not yet publicly revealed'. If admin holds a slot AFTER its reveal time, this endpoint keeps returning that held slot as 'upcoming' (correct per spec), but if network fails during release the slot silently auto-releases at slot+60s - no audit log of hold/release events.

issues: Change-password form has no client-side strength meter or 'show password' toggle - minor UX polish.
Date picker still uses browser-native <input type=date> instead of shadcn Calendar (pre-existing carry-over from iteration 4).

action_items: Optional: add server-side restriction so hold/release only target today's upcoming slot.
Optional: invalidate existing JWTs after password change (rotate a version claim or store token id).
Carry-over from iter 4: unique index on boards.date / super_draws.date, and swap native date input for shadcn Calendar.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now ~590 lines mixing auth/board/hold/super concerns; nearing the 700-line refactor threshold - split into routers/services soon.
seed_admin correctly honours password_changed flag so admin-changed passwords survive restart; verified functionally by the full-cycle test.

slot_reveal_state auto-releases after HOLD_MAX_SECONDS=60 without touching the DB - clean and race-free for reads, but the slot's held/released flags stay set forever in Mongo; consider clearing them on next-day rollover.
